subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept that configured Signal bot identity now makes native-only `requireMention` groups enforce mention gating after upgrade?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and supported, but the patch intentionally changes behavior for existing Signal groups that had bot identity configured without text mention patterns, and automation should not decide that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept stricter native gating
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned messages and keep them only as bounded pending context.

options.title: Require a transition policy
options.body: Ask for an opt-in mode, migration note, or transitional behavior before merge if existing pass-through deployments must be preserved.

options.title: Pause identity-based enforcement
options.body: Pause or close if configured Signal identity should not make mention detection enforceable without separate maintainer-approved policy.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter native gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned messages and keep them only as bounded pending context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared mention-policy history makes this the best available owner for the compatibility decision across channel gates.
